why: The creator, 2026-10-14, on the look test's three levels: "The biggest thing these all miss is the actual gameplay itself ... We were supposed to collect berries, but there were no berries anywhere. I think in the ocean I saw some boxes but those are impossible to get." The pickup part placed every spot at y = 0, which on island terrain is out at sea or inside the ground, and every gate passed. The class: the objective is where no player can get to it. Here the game's own code places the berries past the yard's fence (the smallest change on a flat yard that brings it back); seeds, tumbles and bots are as the example has them, so the round is not idle. Gate D must fail it on measure 6's play leg: most objectives cannot be reached.
